name: Café Zero ~Oboreta Ningyou~
original_name: カフェ・ゼロ～溺れた人魚～
source:
This is a café at the middle of nowhere, the place where wandering ghosts are gathered. Here they will experience the last 7 days of their life once again. Will there really happen any changes within this time period?

[From [url=http://www.roseverte.net/cafe0/eng/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
荒无人烟之地坐落着一家咖啡馆，漂泊的幽灵会在这里聚集。他们将在此重新经历生命最后7天。这段时间真的能带来任何改变吗？

[译自 [url=http://www.roseverte.net/cafe0/eng/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
